claims: The Arizona Wildcats advanced to the 2026 NCAA Tournament Final Four.
The Arizona Wildcats defeated Purdue 79-64 in the Elite Eight on March 28, 2026, in San Jose.
The Arizona Wildcats were led by coach Tommy Lloyd.
Freshman Koa Peat scored 20 points against Purdue.
The Arizona Wildcats erased a seven-point halftime deficit against Purdue.
The Arizona Wildcats reached their first Final Four since 2001.
Ivan Kharchenkov scored 18 points against Purdue.
Brayden Burries scored 14 points against Purdue.
Jaden Bradley scored 14 points against Purdue.
Arizona had a 48-26 scoring advantage over Purdue in the second half, reported by AZ Family.
The halftime score was Purdue 38, Arizona 31, reported by AZ Family.
This marks the 5th Final Four in Arizona Wildcats program history, reports the Arizona Daily Star.
Arizona will play the winner of the Tennessee vs. Michigan Elite Eight game, according to Yahoo Sports.
The 2026 NCAA Tournament Final Four will take place in Indianapolis.
Tommy Lloyd achieved a Final Four appearance in his fifth season, reported by ESPN.
Arizona Wildcats' previous Final Four appearances were in 1988, 1994, 1997, and 2001.
The Arizona Wildcats were National Champions in 1997
